# sub_82B28A00

Initializes a command queue entry. Takes the System pointer in r3 and appends
a record whose handler is selected by the selector in r4.

Stores: handler at ring+0x00, object at ring+0x04.

Windows: two stores from entry registers only.

Gate: none. Deterministic, no callees, all writes enumerable from r3.
